title.en: AN ACT TO AMEND ACT NUMBERED SIX HUNDRED AND TWENTY-EIGHT, ENTITLED "AN ACT CONSOLIDATING THE OFFICES OF PROVINCIAL TREASURER AND PROVINCIAL SUPERVISOR OF THE PROVINCE OF ANTIQUE," BY PROVIDING THAT THE DIVISION SUPERINTENDENT OF SCHOOLS IN THAT PROVINCE MAY APPOINT A DEPUTY TO ACT IN HIS STEAD ON THE PROVINCIAL BOARD.

title.id: Undang-Undang yang mengubah Undang-Undang Nomor 628 tentang Penggabungan Kantor Bendahara Provinsi dan Kantor Pengawas Provinsi di Provinsi Antique dengan menentukan bahwa Kepala Dinas Pendidikan Wilayah dapat mengangkat wakil untuk bertindak atas namanya di Dewan Provinsi
title.ms: Akta yang mengubah Akta Nombor 628 berkenaan Penggabungan Pejabat Bendahari Wilayah dan Pejabat Pengawas Wilayah di Wilayah Antique dengan menetapkan bahawa Pengarah Daerah Pendidikan di wilayah itu boleh melantik seorang timbalan untuk bertindak bagi pihaknya dalam Lembaga Wilayah

text.en:
Section two of Act Numbered Six hundred and twenty-eight, entitled "An Act consolidating the
offices of provincial treasurer and provincial supervisor of the Province of Antique," is hereby amended to
read as follows:
"Section 2. The provincial governor, the provincial supervisor-treasurer, and a teacher of the public schools
resident at the capital of the province and assigned to such duty by the division superintendent of schools for
the province shall constitute the provincial board. The teacher of public schools assigned hereunder shall
receive no additional compensation for his services as a member of the provincial board."

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, August 24, 1903.
